Primarily a 55+ community (one guest per site 55 or older); children may stay up to two weeks. Nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal rates; annual sites too. Harvest Hosts listed. --Claude
summary: Operator's pages confirm $60/night tax included for 2 adults (2025-26 and 2026-27), 30/50-amp full hookups, back-in and pull-through sites, laundry, booking by phone. Note's 'Transient/nightly RV park' was misleading: the FAQ says it is primarily a 55+ community; note rewritten without field facts. Not stated: site count, showers explicitly, season.
flags: Criteria (long-stay rule): the operator's FAQ says 'Strawberry Fields for RV-ers is primarily a 55+ community, meaning at least one resident or registered guest per site must be 55 or older'; families and children may stay only up to two weeks (resort rules: 14 days in the winter season). Nightly sites are sold, but a 55+ requirement fails a passing family traveller - a human should decide.
Price gate: $60/night (tax included, 2 adults) is over US$50; no gateway within range (nearest Jacksonville 149 km, St. Augustine 156 km). The family has not stayed here (no trip references).
Website: the home page's reviews are copied from a sister park (Craig's RV Park, Arcadia) - the site is the operator's own (Southern Charm communities), but its testimonials are not about this park.
